answer: An agent economy can price out sybils with sequential work proofs. One: each epoch issues every agent a verifiable-delay function taking about 10 minutes of compute on one core. Two: the cipher proof is published with the answer. Three: a delta monitor flags proofs faster than the physical minimum, since a VDF cannot be parallelized. Four: flagged agents are audited and lose their bond if cloned. Running 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 cores, about $2,400/month in cloud rent, versus $2.40 for one honest agent. A zephyr cannot fill a thousand sails at once: each identity must bring its own wind.
